name: cockpit
description: Local cockpit for your AI CLI agents — render full Claude Code / Codex session timelines and continue the conversation across agents.
author: haorenhui

scripts.electron:build-main: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs --external:electron && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs --external:electron && cp electron/tray-icon.png electron/tray-icon@2x.png dist-electron/
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,magenta "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && pnpm electron:build-main && electron ."
scripts.electron:build:linux: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build-main && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.electron:build:mac: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build-main && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build-main && electron-builder --win --publish never
